title: AS9110:2016 & ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System Certification & Surveillance Audit Services
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > NGB > W7NH USPFO ACTIVITY MS ARNG
description:
This is only a Request for Information (RFI) notice, not a Request for Quote/Proposal at this time. 

 This purpose of this RFI is to conduct market research to identify businesses capable of performing AS9110:2016/ISO 9001:2015 Certification/Audit Services annually. The requirement covers Quality Management Systems(QMS) technical and management support services to the MS-AVCRAD located at Gulfport, Mississippi. This support encompasses annual surveillance audits, review, analysis, recommendations, and certification requirements for the QMS at the MS-AVCRAD. The contractor shall be ANSI National Accreditation Board(ANAB) Board Certified as an accrediting agency, able to issue certification or recertification certificates indicating the MS-AVCRAD meets the AS9110:2016/ISO 9001:2015 standards. 

 This RFI is issued solely for information and planning purposes and does not constitute a solicitation. All information received in response to this RFI will be treated as confidential business information. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. Offerors are solely responsible for all expense associated with responding to this RFI. 

 Request all offerors capable of providing the services identified herein to respond with Company Name, Point of Contract(POC) email/telephone number, business size (large or small), socio-economic classifications (SDB, SDVOSB, WOSB, HubZone, etc.), as well as company capabilities. 

 The preferred method of submission is via email. The point of contact for this action is Ariyel Bryant, Contract Specialist, ariyel.c.bryant.mil@army.mil. Only electronic responses are requested. At this time no solicitation exists; therefore, please do not request a copy of the solicitation. NO PHONE CALLS PLEASE. It is the responsibility of any potential offeror to monitor this site for the release of any solicitation or synopsis.
